mu_name_from: Loaded as MODEL_DEVILS_EYE + i (MODEL_POTION + 17 + i) from Data\\Item\\Devil0i.bmd for i < 3 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:915-916, _enum.h:2087-2089): Devil00 the Eye, Devil01 the Key, Devil02 the Invitation. Names as OpenMU's, Version095d/Items/EventTicketItems.cs:29-31 (WebZen's item.txt calls the third 'Ticket to Devil Square').
why_this_one: Devil Square's ticket. The Devil's Eye and the Devil's Key of one level with a Jewel of Chaos make the Devil's Invitation of that level in the Chaos Machine; the Invitation lets him in through Charon in Noria. The level is the square's, carried in the refinement, +1 to +4 in 0.95d (OpenMU MaximumItemLevel 4). docs/worlds/devil-square-port.md.
profile_note: As the Ale and the Firecracker: a small object in the bag and on the ground.
tells: The remaining time is shown when you right click on your mouse.
tells_from: MU's two lines joined, GT 'The remaining time is shown' and 'when you right click on your mouse.', Game.en.resx:2424-2429, white, on the Invitation alone (ZzzInventory.cpp:3940-3951): a right click on it in the bag says how long to the square's next opening (NewUIInventoryActionController.cpp:800). Its name yellow, as the Blood Castle tickets' (ZzzInventory.cpp:2186-2189, 5801-5804): our gold.
tells_note: The right click itself is not built here; it waits on the square's clock.

stats.note: Group, number and size are WebZen's row and OpenMU's; durability is OpenMU's 1 (group 14 in item.txt carries no durability column: Value, Level). Not in the ordinary drop -- the eye and the key fall on their own roll, to be built separately (OpenMU makes a DropItemGroup per level at 1%: +1 from monster level 2, +2 from 36, +3 from 47, +4 from 60).
